errata: E1 (README (a), wording/evidence; minor): 'data/census_t9.json is byte-identical to the design-time analysis/census_t9.json (cmp passed)' is vacuous. scripts/select_seeds.py writes analysis/census_t9.json (OUT = ../analysis/census_t9.json), so stage (a) overwrote the design-time file at 2026-11-03T21:59:54Z (same mtime as data/census_t9.txt) and run.sh then cp'd it into data/. The cmp compared a file with its own copy. analysis/ is git-ignored, so the design-time bytes are not preserved. The substantive claim does hold: the validator's independent re-implementation and a scratch-copy run of select_seeds.py reproduce data/census_t9.{txt,json} byte-for-byte, and they match all 15 rows of the frozen PROTOCOL.md table.

E2 (README Files; minor): 'SHA256SUMS covers every file under data/ except run.log and itself' is inaccurate. The find ! -name run.log rule also leaves out data/ecbench/run.log (the ecbench run stdout, 14,208 bytes) and data/ecbench_attempt0_refused_busy_host/run.log. These three logs are unhashed in the lead. Their sha256 at validation is recorded in this report. All 118 listed files verify.

E3 (README Headline and band verdicts; scope qualifier): the headline 'end-to-end S 0.5605x seed 0' and 's1308 < seed 0 at every weight' hold only with the 13,528,559-group-op (37,349 S) seed search amortised, i.e. left out. Charged to one target, s1308/seed 0 is 1397.6x at w=0, 0.586x at w=0.1 and 0.563x at w=1, so it is not ordered across the band. The README discloses this in 'Seed search, reported separately', as the protocol prescribed, but the headline does not carry the qualifier. s1308 vs s1093 is unaffected because both rules pay the same search.

E4 (procedure; non-material to counts): adding --allow-busy to 'ecbench run' changed the frozen command after the refused attempt. PROTOCOL.md requires such changes in a dated addendum written before the data. None was written; the change is disclosed only after the fact in README Deviations 1, with the exact diff kept in data/run_c_allowbusy.sh.used (the flag plus an absolute D=). It does not change counted units: the lead's 16 replays, the validator's 4 replays and the engine reruns are all count-identical. The protocol's isolation level was L0 in any case.

E5 (reproducibility binding): the frozen spec ecbench/spec.json is git-ignored and was never committed. It is bound only by its sha256 f5b110d5...0c360c in the committed scripts/run.sh, and it matches. README.md, data/ and analysis/ are uncommitted as well. The source commit and toolchain of both prebuilt binaries are unrecorded (session git_commit and git_dirty are null). src/cryptanalysis/{ecbench/methods.rs, ic_boundary.rs, ic_framework/pkm_semaev.rs} changed between 505ecbb and HEAD, so the binaries cannot be rebuilt from a named commit. Only their sha256 identifies them.

E6 (classification; minor): the README calls the change 'a constant-factor change' but gives no AGENTS.md section-3 class label (advance, engineering, relabelling or accounting). The validator does not assign one. Choosing the class is left to the core tier.
